headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of June 18, 2026, the portfolio has delivered an average return of 16.37%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 10.20%. This results in an average alpha of 6.17%, indicating that the portfolio is not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 29.76%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', still managed a return of 9.24%, which is above the benchmark but lower than the portfolio average. This outperformance relative to SPY is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty, reinforcing the portfolio's strength in a challenging environment. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
